reason: I read reviews before I call anyone, and this page gives me no crew reviews, no explanation of how crews get checked (it just says to be defined), and no answer if a crew walks off mid-job. Free to me is nice, but the money still goes to a crew I cannot vet.
objection: Will the crew in Tbilisi actually bid on a standard brief, and who checks them before they are listed?
would_change_my_mind: Published reviews of real Tbilisi crews who have finished jobs through this, plus a clear written rule for what happens to my money and my flat if a crew stops mid-job.
